user_context: Benchmark académico: presentar márgenes operativos y análisis de sensibilidad, sin afirmar utilidad financiera.
timing: Defined after inspection of the current test, before any proposed advanced model is trained or evaluated. It is not a pre-test margin for the completed study.
metric: RMSE of unannualized sigma7 at h1 on the same independently evaluated dates
justification: Transparent academic operating convention, consistent with the project existing5percent persistence criterion and examined against1/2.5/5/10percent sensitivities. Not an economically validated minimum.
decision_rule: For a future meaningful improvement claim, the advanced method must exceed5percent relative RMSE reduction versus each reference on a new independent evaluation, with declared multiplicity and uncertainty. Point estimates alone do not establish the claim.
hypotheses: Two directional comparisons of reference-adjusted improvement; future pilot estimates differences centered at the5percent boundary.
planning_note: Bonferroni conservative planning for two comparisons; beta<=.10 each bounds joint false-negative probability by .20. These are hypothetical normal paired-seed assumptions, not achieved power.
power_model: For each scenario set one common advanced mean=(1-q_alternative)*persistence_CV_RMSE. Mean boundary difference_j=(1-.05)*reference_j_mean-advanced_mean. Variance versus neural baseline uses (1-.05)^2 sigmaB^2+sigmaA^2-2(1-.05)rho sigmaA sigmaB; persistence is deterministic over training seeds.
rank_test_floor_note: Use at least six for rank tests; the normal t-based power calculation does not establish rank-test power.
